component.name: Afterword
component.summary: Local-first AI meeting notes and summaries

description.p: Afterword is a privacy-first AI meeting assistant that captures, transcribes, and summarizes meetings entirely on your own machine. It records microphone and system audio together, transcribes speech locally, and produces structured notes and summaries without sending your conversations to a third-party server by default.

Recordings are saved to your Videos folder and transcription models are stored under your local application data directory, so meeting content stays on disk under your control. Network access is only used for actions you choose yourself, such as downloading a transcription model or calling an external LLM API for summarization.

Afterword integrates with the desktop through system notifications and a tray icon, and can capture both your microphone and the audio played by other applications (via PulseAudio/PipeWire monitor sources), so you can transcribe calls made through any conferencing app.
See the GitHub release notes for details.
